svg.title: The exam
svg.text: Exam: three of the champions, from the start
cyan: seed 3 gen 20 (one track), its first lap. Best lap 13.83 s; my Exam lap is 32.02 s
yellow: seed 3 gen 80 (one track) brakes to a dead stop in the hairpin, which turns right, at 5.60 s.
pink: it keeps BRAKE down (reverse, from a standstill) and backs into the wall at 6.17 s.
✕: where the four three-track champions crashed (gen 10 at 5.95 s, gen 20 at 5.80 s, gen 80 at 5.95 s, gen 100 at 11.60 s)
